title: emergencyWithdraw does not credit forfeited pending back to rewardBudget, causing invariant drift

classification.assetImpact: Accounting invariant drift: NatSpec invariant balance == rewardBudget + totalDebt breaks upward by the forfeited amount on each emergency exit. Forfeited phUSD becomes phantom debt that no user can claim against. No funds leave the contract.
attackPath: 1. User with non-zero pending calls emergencyWithdraw.
2. user.amount and user.rewardDebt zeroed; totalStaked decremented; pending forfeited.
3. rewardBudget NOT credited back; forfeited phUSD sits on-contract unreferenced.
4. totalDebt() reads balance - rewardBudget and over-reports by the forfeited amount until a future top-up folds it in.
classification.likelihood: moderate (any emergencyWithdraw with non-zero pending triggers it), but impact is observability-only.

justification: Low/QA. Pure accounting-invariant drift; no loss of funds (orphaned phUSD remains on the contract and is implicitly reusable for payouts or future budget folds). totalDebt() view over-reports transiently. Fits QA/Low: 'State handling, function incorrect as to spec, issues with comments.'
